# Setup

```{r setup}
#| output: false
here::i_am("building_models/10_three_waves.qmd")
source(here::here("R", "data_import_and_cleaning.R"))
source(here::here("R", "func_prep_data.R"))

library(gfoRmula)
library(gFormulaMI)
library(magrittr)
library(SPHSUgraphs)
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(DiagrammeR)

pop_data <- import_data() |> 
  select(-econ_incquint) 

ggplot2::theme_set(theme_sphsu_light())

# Filter for only those observed at wave 2 (baseline), and wave 6

pop_dt <- pop_data |> 
  filter(wave == 2, response == 1) |> 
  select(pidp) |> 
  left_join(pop_data, by = "pidp") |> 
  filter(wave == 6, response == 1) |> 
  select(pidp) |> 
  left_join(pop_data, by = "pidp") |> 
  filter(!is.na(mastat_dv_base)) |> 
  mutate(dnc = factor(dnc) |> fct_collapse(zero = "0", one = "1", other_level = "2+")) |> 
  data.table::as.data.table()

long_data <- pop_dt[, `:=`(
  t0 = t0 - 2,
  pcs_lagged = shift(sf12pcs_dv, type = "lag"), # when it acts as a confounder, it should be lagged, when it acts as an outcome, it should not be lagged
# mcs_lagged = shift(sf12mcs_dv, type = "lag"), # when it acts as a confounder, it should be lagged, when it acts as an outcome, it should not be lagged
# the other time-varying confounders should also be lagged
  lagged_dnc = shift(dnc, type = "lag"),
  lagged_home_owner = shift(home_owner, type = "lag"),
  lagged_econ_benefits = shift(econ_benefits, type = "lag"),
  mcs_outcome = sf12mcs_dv
)][wave %in% 3:6]

no_mh_outcomes <- long_data |> 
  group_by(pidp) |> 
  summarise(n_missing = sum(is.na(sf12mcs_dv)), base_missing = all(is.na(sf12mcs_dv_base))) |> 
  filter(n_missing == 2, base_missing) |> 
  select(pidp) |> 
  as.data.table()

long_data <- long_data[!no_mh_outcomes, on = .(pidp)] 

intervention_pattern_2 <- expand_grid(0:1, 0:1) |>
  t() |>
  as_tibble(.name_repair = "minimal") |>
  unclass()

intervention_pattern_3 <- expand_grid(0:1, 0:1, 0:1) |>
  t() |>
  as_tibble(.name_repair = "minimal") |>
  unclass()
```

# Three periods of intervention - static baseline

```{r model-baseline3-dag}
#| echo: false
#| output: true
grViz("digraph {
  graph []
  node [fontname=Arial]
  P0 [label=<PCS<SUB>1</SUB>>]
  P1 [label=<PCS<SUB>2</SUB>>]
  P2 [label=<PCS<SUB>3</SUB>>]
  E0 [label=<Empl<SUB>1</SUB>>]
  E1 [label=<Empl<SUB>2</SUB>>]
  E2 [label=<Empl<SUB>3</SUB>>]
  I0 [label=<Inc<SUB>1</SUB>>]
  I1 [label=<Inc<SUB>2</SUB>>]
  I2 [label=<Inc<SUB>3</SUB>>]
  C0 [label=<Conf<SUP>Int</SUP><SUB>1</SUB>>]
  C1 [label=<Conf<SUP>Int</SUP><SUB>2</SUB>>]
  C2 [label=<Conf<SUP>Int</SUP><SUB>3</SUB>>]
  Y [label=<<I>MCS<SUB>3</SUB></I>>]
  edge []
  P0 -> E0, I0, C0, P1
  P1 -> E1, I1, C1, P2
  P2 -> E2, I2, C2, Y
  E0 -> I0, C0, P1, E1
  E1 -> I1, C1, P2, E2
  E2 -> I2, C2, Y
  I0 -> C0, P1, E1, I1
  I1 -> C1, P2, E2, I2
  I2 -> C2, Y
  C0 -> P1, E1, I1, C1
  C1 -> P2, E2, I2, C2
  C2 -> Y
  {rank=min; P0, P1, P2}
  {rank=same; E0, E1, E2}
  {rank=same; I0, I1, I2}
  {rank=max; C0, C1, C2, Y}
}")
```

# Setup wide data for MI
```{r setup-wide}
wide_data <- long_data |>
  mutate(econ_emp_bin = as_factor(econ_emp_bin)) |> 
  make_wide(
    pidp,
    t0,
    base_cols = c(sex_dv_base, # wave 1
                  wnw_race_base, # wave 1
                  hiqual_dv_base, # wave 1
                  age_dv_base, # wave 1
                  gor_dv_base, # wave 1
                  mastat_dv_base, # wave 1
                  sf12mcs_dv_base # wave 1
                  ), 
    outcome = sf12mcs_dv,
    pcs_lagged,
    econ_emp_bin,
    log_income,
    lagged_dnc,
    lagged_home_owner,
    lagged_econ_benefits,
    econ_dist,
    static = FALSE,
    waves = c(1,2,3)
  )

if (file.exists(here::here("data", "wide_mids_3_waves_mcs_dynamic.rds"))) {
wide_mids <- readRDS(here::here("data", "wide_mids_3_waves_mcs_dynamic.rds"))
message("Loaded mice from 'data'")

} else {
if (!dir.exists(here::here("data")))
{
dir.create(here::here("data"))
message("Directory 'data' did not exist. Creating directory 'data'")
}
message("Creating wide_mids.rds into 'data'")
wide_mids <- mice::mice(wide_data, defaultMethod = c("norm", "logreg", "pmm", "pmm"), m = 35, maxit = 10)
saveRDS(wide_mids, file = here::here("data", "wide_mids_3_waves_mcs_dynamic.rds"))
message("Computed wide_mids and saved to 'data'")
}

#wide_mids <- readRDS(here::here("data", "wide_mids_full_models_MI_only.rds"))

base_predictor_matrix <- make_predictor_matrix(wide_data)
```

## gFormulaMI with accumulating variables: three waves of intervention

```{r 3waves_mi}
regimes <- intervention_pattern_3

predictor_matrix <- base_predictor_matrix

# MCS does not predict intermediate outcomes
predictor_matrix[,"sf12mcs_dv_1"] <- 0
predictor_matrix[,"sf12mcs_dv_2"] <- 0

# MCS is dependent on previous MCS values
predictor_matrix["sf12mcs_dv_2","sf12mcs_dv_1"] <- 1
predictor_matrix["sf12mcs_dv_3","sf12mcs_dv_2"] <- 1

# MCS is not predicted by baseline MCS, only by their immediate previous value
predictor_matrix["sf12mcs_dv_2","sf12mcs_dv_base"] <- 0
predictor_matrix["sf12mcs_dv_3","sf12mcs_dv_base"] <- 0

# MCS in period t (not baseline) predicts employment and income in the period t+1
predictor_matrix["sf12mcs_dv_1",c("econ_emp_bin_2", "log_income_2")] <- 1
predictor_matrix["sf12mcs_dv_2",c("econ_emp_bin_3", "log_income_3")] <- 1

# Economic distress does not affect income or employment of the next period
predictor_matrix["econ_dist_1",c("econ_emp_bin_2", "log_income_2")] <- 0
predictor_matrix["econ_dist_2",c("econ_emp_bin_3", "log_income_3")] <- 0

imps <- gFormulaImpute(
  wide_mids,
  trtVars = c("econ_emp_bin_1", "econ_emp_bin_2", "econ_emp_bin_3"),
  trtRegimes = regimes,
  predictorMatrix = predictor_matrix
)

fits <- imps %$%
  lm(sf12mcs_dv_3 ~ 0 + factor(regime))

mi_3cummulative <- syntheticPool(fits)

regimes_3 <- tibble(intervention = regimes |>
  map(paste, collapse = "-") |>
  reduce(c)
)

regime_obs_n <- wide_data |>
  mutate(across(c(econ_emp_bin_1, econ_emp_bin_2, econ_emp_bin_3), as.character)) |>
  filter(!is.na(econ_emp_bin_1), !is.na(econ_emp_bin_2), !is.na(econ_emp_bin_3)) |>
  count(econ_emp_bin_1, econ_emp_bin_2, econ_emp_bin_3) |>
  mutate(intervention = paste(econ_emp_bin_1, econ_emp_bin_2, econ_emp_bin_3, sep = "-")) |>
  select(intervention, n_obs = n)
```

## Comparing results

```{r 3wavesmi-tab}
#| output: true
mod_3cummulative <- mi_3cummulative |>
  as_tibble() |>
  rownames_to_column("Intervention") |>
  transmute(mi_effect = Estimate,
            mi_se = sqrt(Total),
            mi_ll = `95% CI L`,
            mi_ul = `95% CI U`) |>
  bind_cols(regimes_3) |>
  left_join(regime_obs_n, by = "intervention") |>
  mutate(n_obs = replace_na(n_obs, 0L))

mod_3cummulative |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

```{r 3wavesmi-graph}
#| output: true
mod_3cummulative |>
  mutate(
    n_unemp = map_int(intervention, ~ length(str_extract_all(.x, "1", simplify = TRUE))) |> factor(),
    intervention = paste0(intervention, " (n=", n_obs, ")")
  ) |>
  select(-n_obs) |>
  pivot_longer(
    -c(intervention, n_unemp),
    names_to = c("Calculation method", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_(.*)"
  ) |>
ggplot(aes(effect, intervention, shape = `Calculation method`, xmin = ll, xmax = ul,
    colour = n_unemp)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.7))  +
  geom_errorbar(width = 0.3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
  scale_colour_brewer(name = "Number of unemployed periods", palette = "Set1") +
  facet_wrap(~`Calculation method`, ncol = 1)
```

```{r setup-wide-static}
wide_data <- long_data |>
  mutate(econ_emp_bin = as_factor(econ_emp_bin)) |> 
  make_wide(
    pidp,
    t0,
    base_cols = c(sex_dv_base, # wave 1
                  wnw_race_base, # wave 1
                  hiqual_dv_base, # wave 1

                  gor_dv_base, # wave 1
                  mastat_dv_base, # wave 1
                  sf12mcs_dv_base # wave 1
                  ), 
    outcome = sf12mcs_dv,
    pcs_lagged,
    econ_emp_bin,
    log_income,
    lagged_dnc,
    lagged_home_owner,
    lagged_econ_benefits,
    econ_dist,
    static = TRUE,
    waves = c(1,2,3)
  )

if (file.exists(here::here("data", "wide_mids_3_waves_mcs_static.rds"))) {
wide_mids <- readRDS(here::here("data", "wide_mids_3_waves_mcs_static.rds"))
message("Loaded mice from 'data'")

} else {
if (!dir.exists(here::here("data")))
{
dir.create(here::here("data"))
message("Directory 'data' did not exist. Creating directory 'data'")
}

wide_mids <- mice::mice(wide_data, defaultMethod = c("norm", "logreg", "pmm", "pmm"), m = 35, maxit = 10)
saveRDS(wide_mids, file = here::here("data", "wide_mids_3_waves_mcs_static.rds"))

#wide_mids <- readRDS(here::here("data", "wide_mids_full_models_MI_only.rds"))

base_predictor_matrix <- make_predictor_matrix(wide_data)
```

```{r 3static-mi}
regimes <- intervention_pattern_3

predictor_matrix <- base_predictor_matrix

# predictor_matrix["sf12mcs_dv_0",] <- 0
# predictor_matrix["sf12mcs_dv_1",] <- 0
# predictor_matrix["sf12mcs_dv_2",] <- 0

# MCS does not predict intermediate outcomes
predictor_matrix[,"sf12mcs_dv_1"] <- 0
predictor_matrix[,"sf12mcs_dv_3"] <- 0

# MCS is dependent on previous MCS values
predictor_matrix["sf12mcs_dv_3","sf12mcs_dv_1"] <- 1

# MCS is not predicted by baseline MCS
predictor_matrix["sf12mcs_dv_3","sf12mcs_dv_base"] <- 0

# MCS in period t (not baseline) predicts employment and income in the period t+1
predictor_matrix["sf12mcs_dv_1",c("econ_emp_bin_2", "log_income_2")] <- 1

# Economic distress does not affect income or employment of the next period
predictor_matrix["econ_dist_1",c("econ_emp_bin_2", "log_income_2")] <- 0

imps <- gFormulaImpute(
  wide_mids,
  trtVars = c("econ_emp_bin_1", "econ_emp_bin_2", "econ_emp_bin_3"),
  trtRegimes = regimes,
  predictorMatrix = predictor_matrix
)

fits <- imps %$%
  lm(sf12mcs_dv_3 ~ 0 + factor(regime))

mi_3static <- syntheticPool(fits)

regimes_3 <- tibble(intervention = regimes |>
  map(paste, collapse = "-") |>
  reduce(c)
)

regime_obs_n <- wide_data |>
  mutate(across(c(econ_emp_bin_1, econ_emp_bin_2, econ_emp_bin_3), as.character)) |>
  filter(!is.na(econ_emp_bin_1), !is.na(econ_emp_bin_2), !is.na(econ_emp_bin_3)) |>
  count(econ_emp_bin_1, econ_emp_bin_2, econ_emp_bin_3) |>
  mutate(intervention = paste(econ_emp_bin_1, econ_emp_bin_2, econ_emp_bin_3, sep = "-")) |>
  select(intervention, n_obs = n)
```
